design_summary.purpose: Provide an 8-bit programmable PWM controller that generates pwm_out by comparing a synchronous counter against a duty-cycle threshold, while exposing the current counter_value for observation.
design_summary.operating_model: The design operates on the rising edge of clk. reset_n is a synchronous active-low reset that clears all registers to zero and dominates enable. When reset_n is high and enable is asserted, counter_value increments by one until it reaches period, at which point it wraps to zero on the same clock edge. When enable is low, counter_value holds its prior value. pwm_out is a combinational reflection of the current counter_value compared against duty_cycle and is high exactly when counter_value is strictly less than duty_cycle.

external_interfaces.name: clk
external_interfaces.role: Primary clock input for all state updates.

external_interfaces.name: reset_n
external_interfaces.role: Synchronous active-low reset input that clears registers to zero.

external_interfaces.name: enable
external_interfaces.role: Counter update gate; when low, the counter holds its value.

external_interfaces.name: duty_cycle
external_interfaces.role: Programmable PWM threshold used for comparison against the counter.

external_interfaces.name: period
external_interfaces.role: Programmable wrap value used to synchronously reset the counter to zero when matched.

external_interfaces.name: pwm_out
external_interfaces.role: PWM output asserted when counter_value is less than duty_cycle.

external_interfaces.name: counter_value
external_interfaces.role: Observed current counter state exposed externally.

module_architecture.name: pwm_controller
module_architecture.role: Single-module flat architecture implementing the complete PWM function with no submodules, memories, or buses.
responsibilities: Maintain a synchronous 8-bit counter with programmable wrap behavior.
Generate a combinational PWM output from the current counter value and duty cycle.
Expose the current counter value for external monitoring.
Honor synchronous active-low reset and enable gating.
Support fully synthesizable RTL implementation with simple sequential logic and comparison logic.
interface_notes: Receives clk, reset_n, enable, duty_cycle, and period as the complete input interface.
Drives pwm_out and counter_value as the complete output interface.
counter_value is a direct observation point for the internal counter state.
pwm_out is derived from the current counter_value and duty_cycle without additional state.
ownership_notes: The module owns the entire state model for the 8-bit counter.
The module does not instantiate or delegate behavior to any child modules.
All externally visible behavior is contained in the top_module named pwm_controller.

data_flow_summary: reset_n synchronously clears the internal counter state to 8'h00 on the rising edge of clk.
When reset_n is deasserted and enable is high, the counter advances by one per clock unless the current count equals period, in which case it wraps to 8'h00.
When enable is low, the counter retains its previous value and no state transition occurs.
counter_value mirrors the current internal counter state directly to the output port.
pwm_out is generated combinationally as the result of counter_value < duty_cycle.
The current period input affects wrap behavior only on enabled clock edges; duty_cycle affects the PWM comparison continuously as a sampled level input.

clock_reset_summary.clocking: All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk. The operating clock domain is clk at 50.0 MHz nominal, with a 20.0 ns period.
clock_reset_summary.reset_behavior: reset_n is synchronous active-low and dominates enable. When reset_n is low at a rising edge of clk, the counter and all registers are cleared to 8'h00, yielding counter_value = 8'h00 and pwm_out low at the observation point. After reset is released, counting resumes only when enable is high. The design also preserves the specified wrap behavior when period is 8'h00, causing a repeating count of 0 on each enabled clock.

integration_notes: Connect clk, reset_n, enable, duty_cycle, and period exactly as named in the specification.
Observe pwm_out and counter_value as the only driven outputs.
No additional hierarchy, renamed ports, or filenames are implied by this description.
The design is intended to be synthesizable with straightforward sequential counter logic and comparison logic.
